fullWorkExperienceText:
I'm an IT Infrastructure Consultant working across Microsoft 365, Azure, and Entra ID. I got here through a non-obvious route—HVAC tech, NBN telecommunications, then a Web Development Fast Track at Coder Academy before landing in enterprise IT. Turns out, years of diagnosing physical systems and learning to code gave me a pretty useful combination: I troubleshoot like a technician and automate like a developer.

Day to day, I handle Level 2 and Level 3 escalations—the stuff that's too complex for the service desk but doesn't need to go all the way to the cloud engineers yet. That means a lot of SharePoint engineering, advanced M365 issues, and writing PowerShell and Python scripts to kill off tedious admin tasks.

I care about the people side of this work. The best fix isn't just technically correct—it's one that actually makes sense for the person using the system and the team supporting it. I try to keep that front of mind.

Outside of work, I run a home lab with Proxmox, Hyper-V, and enterprise networking gear. I use it to mess around with AI agent deployments, full-stack dev projects, and whatever else I'm curious about that week.

Certifications: AZ-900 · ITIL 4 Foundation · Certified SCRUM Master

Senior Consultant at Capgemini (Dec 2021 - Present)
- Managed largest SharePoint farm in Southern Hemisphere: 660,000+ users, 1,000+ sites, 99.9% uptime
- Ultimate Tier-3 escalation point across M365/SharePoint Online and Google Workspace, achieving 15% reduction in repeat incidents
- Engineered PnP PowerShell to audit and enforce MFA compliance across 200+ SharePoint sites with automated reporting
- Administered Exchange Hybrid and Teams, resolving complex mail-flow, calendar, and federation issues
- Oversaw AD/Entra ID/Google Workspace sync, resolving identity conflicts for seamless SSO
- Spearheaded Azure cloud adoption and legacy application remediation, aligned with ACSC Essential 8
- Built ServiceNow integration with M365 presence data and algorithmic workload engine eliminating manual triage
- Produced RCA reports and knowledge base reducing resolution time and improving team onboarding

Information Technology Support Specialist at Australia Post (Feb 2026 - Sep 2026)
- Delivered L1/L2 face-to-face and remote technical support within the MyITHub service centre at Australia Post's Burnley site — a walk-in hub covering device repair, OS reimaging, loan device management, new employee provisioning, and accessories fulfillment
- Engineered custom keystroke injection automation (macro-level scripting) to circumvent stringent system access controls within ServiceNow, fully automating repetitive ITSM ticket creation and modification workflows and eliminating significant manual data-entry overhead
- Managed end-to-end endpoint lifecycle tasks including OS migrations, device imaging, Autopilot/UEM enrolment, and compliant equipment disposal — ensuring every device left the hub deployment-ready
- Maintained the hub's spares and accessories inventory, reviewing stock watermarks monthly and contributing to a ServiceNow Stock Accessories module implementation to improve SLA visibility
- Supported rollout of a self-help kiosk programme enabling staff to independently access the Knowledge Base, perform password resets, log tickets, and book hub appointments
- Acted as escalation point for complex infrastructure faults, collaborating with L3 teams to drive incidents to resolution while maintaining accurate ServiceNow documentation and SLA compliance

Migration Engineer at St John of God Health Care (Oct 2025 - Jan 2026)
- Led a Windows 11 enterprise migration across more than 100 clinical endpoints, managing application validation, compliance checks, user handover, and training in live clinical environment with zero disruption to patient care

SharePoint M365 Engineer at Department of Education (Dec 2021 - Dec 2025)
- Managed and maintained the largest SharePoint farm in the Southern Hemisphere — 660,000+ active users across 1,000+ sites — executing critical CRs and security patching achieving 99.9% uptime
- Acted as the ultimate Tier-3 escalation point across M365/SharePoint Online and Google Workspace, leading RCA to permanently eliminate recurring faults — resulting in a documented 15% reduction in repeat incidents
- Engineered PnP PowerShell automation to dynamically audit and enforce MFA compliance across 200+ sensitive SharePoint sites, generating automated compliance reports for stakeholder review
- Administered Exchange Hybrid environments alongside Microsoft Teams, resolving complex mail-flow, calendar, and federation issues across the entire organisation
- Oversaw synchronisation of On-Premise Active Directory, Entra ID (Azure AD), and Google Workspace, resolving identity conflicts and authentication failures to maintain seamless SSO
- Spearheaded Azure cloud adoption and legacy application remediation, aligning hybrid-cloud infrastructure with ACSC Essential 8 and modern enterprise security baselines
- Produced detailed as-built documentation and RCA reports, creating a knowledge base that reduced resolution time for recurring incidents and improved team onboarding

Application Support Engineer at Knosys (ASX:KNO) (Dec 2020 - Dec 2021)
- Delivered expert L3 application support for Knosys's enterprise intranet platform (GreenOrbit), achieving a 95% issue resolution rate within SLA for clients including Cotton On and Harvey Norman
- Engineered PowerShell automation to replace manual data compilation during cloud migrations — reducing processing time by 87% (2 hours → 15 minutes) and saving 10+ hours of overhead per month
- Developed Python and PowerShell scripts to streamline system patching procedures, reducing manual patching effort by 20% and improving patch-cycle consistency
- Contributed to a complex platform upgrade and AWS migration, authoring RCA documentation that permanently resolved recurring version conflicts and became the reference guide for future cycles
- Diagnosed deep application-layer issues including database query failures, API integration errors, and front-end rendering defects, frequently engaging the development team to engineer code-level fixes

Sharepoint Developer / Consultant & Application Support Developer at Engage Squared (Mar 2018 - Dec 2020)
- Delivered bespoke SharePoint Online intranet solutions for major enterprise clients — including Victoria Police and Transurban — using custom SPFx components built with React and TypeScript
- Implemented full CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps and Git, automating build, test, and release processes and reducing deployment cycle times by 25%
- Led end-to-end migration of legacy on-premise SharePoint intranets to M365, architecting governance frameworks and permission structures to ensure ISO 27001 compliance from day one
- Facilitated client-facing technical workshops and product demonstrations, driving a 20% increase in enterprise adoption of new M365 platform features
- Collaborated with UX designers and project managers in an Agile/Scrum delivery model, contributing to sprint planning, backlog refinement, and retrospectives
- Application Support Developer (Sep 2019 – Dec 2020): Provided technical production support and ongoing enhancements

Telecommunications Specialist / Field Technician at BSA Limited. (Aug 2016 - Dec 2017)
- Delivered telecommunications field technician services and physical Layer 1 infrastructure deployments, structured cabling (fibre and copper), and diagnostics across commercial and residential sites
